name: Incendiary Prayer
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range 40 ft.

Area aura centered on you
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You utter a prayer of cleansing fires. All allies within the aura gain a fire resistance of 5. All enemies beginning their turn in or entering the aura take 1d6 fire damage. A successful Fortitude save reduced that damage taken that round to 1.
